summaries.text: This resolution designates December 13, 2025, as National Wreaths Across America Day and honors the Wreaths Across America project, patriotic escort units, the U.S. trucking industry, and the volunteers and donors involved in this tradition. Additionally, the resolution recognizes the service and sacrifices of veterans, members of the Armed Forces, and their families.

title: A resolution designating December 13, 2025, as "National Wreaths Across America Day".
